reported.summary: Corrected research: serialize-state cross-request UAF; cached-pointer chain is dead at the addref
reported.notes: The public bundle was corrected: the cached-pointer chain is not a UAF because Z_TRY_ADDREF(progress->data) keeps the progress array alive; CVE-2026-109619 maps to that dead chain. The real memory-safety bug is a serialize-state cross-request UAF at var.c:756 (data->n += 1), reachable on prefork SAPIs and not RCE. CVE-2026-109618 is the provisional mapping; vendor confirmation is pending. serializer-context-reset.patch resets the orphaned BG serializer state at request startup for PHP 5.6 and 7.0-8.5, with PHP 8.2 validated end-to-end.
